name: Optimize
author: Miguel Bolivar
description: AI-driven disk and package optimizer. Scans the system, asks the default coding agent for recommendations, and lets you act on them from a bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: AI-generated recommendations to free disk space, archive or upload large files, and uninstall unused packages.

schema.label: Scan interval (days)
schema.description: How often the weekly timer triggers a fresh scan.

schema.label: Cloud upload handler
schema.description: Handler invoked for recommendations with action=cloud.

schema.label: Analysis agent
schema.description: Agent used to analyze the snapshot. 'default' respects the omarchy-default-agent setting.
